records.name: Bishop Heber College
records.description: Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, is an autonomous Christian minority institution affiliated with Bharathidasan University, established in 1966. It is known for its strong undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sciences, commerce, arts, and humanities, and has been accredited with 'A+' grade by NAAC. The college is particularly recognized for its mathematics, physics, and computer science departments.

records.name: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics
records.description: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics (NMCC) Mumbai is a leading autonomous commerce college affiliated with the University of Mumbai, known for strong BCom and BMS programs. The college has consistently ranked among Mumbai's top commerce institutions and is recognized for its academic rigor, industry interface, and placement record. It offers specialized programs in commerce, economics, and management with a focus on professional readiness.

records.name: Presidency College
records.description: Presidency College Chennai, established in 1840, is one of India's oldest and most distinguished government arts and science colleges, affiliated with the University of Madras. It is renowned for its programs in mathematics, physics, chemistry, economics, and humanities, having produced several eminent scientists and scholars. The college holds autonomous status and NAAC 'A+' accreditation, and is a landmark institution in South Indian education.

records.name: Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) Institute
records.description: BSE Institute Ltd. (BIL), a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE Ltd. (Bombay Stock Exchange), offers specialized programs in finance, capital markets, and financial services. It provides certificate, diploma, and postgraduate programs in areas such as investment banking, equity research, financial planning, and commodity markets. BSE Institute's location in India's financial capital and its industry connections provide students with unmatched exposure to live markets and finance professionals.

records.name: National Institute of Financial Management (NIFM)
records.description: National Institute of Financial Management (NIFM) Faridabad is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, offering postgraduate programs in financial management for civil servants and professionals. It offers a prestigious Post Graduate Diploma in Management (Financial Management) primarily for Indian Revenue Service officers and a management program for finance professionals. NIFM is a key institution for building financial management capacity within the Indian government.

records.name: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR)
records.description: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR) Chennai, established in 1970, is a leading management institution known for its MBA and research programs with a focus on financial management, development finance, and economics. IFMR Graduate School of Business (now merged with Krea University) is recognized for its rigorous curriculum and strong research culture. The institute has significant contributions to microfinance research and financial inclusion policy in India.

records.name: NID Haryana
records.description: National Institute of Design (NID) Haryana, located in Kurukshetra, is one of the newer campuses under the National Institute of Design network established by the Government of India. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in industrial design, communication design, and textile design. NID Haryana aims to foster design thinking and innovation, serving the design education needs of northern India.

records.name: Srishti Manipal Institute of Art Design and Technology
records.description: Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design and Technology Bengaluru is a leading creative institution now part of Manipal Academy of Higher Education, offering programs in design, arts, media, and technology. It is known for its progressive, practice-based pedagogy that encourages interdisciplinary creativity and critical thinking. Srishti offers BDes, MDes, MFA, and PhD programs, and is recognized for producing innovative designers and artists.

records.name: Sir JJ College of Architecture
records.description: Sir J.J. College of Architecture Mumbai, established in 1896, is one of India's oldest and most prestigious architecture schools, affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers BArch and MArch programs and has shaped the architectural heritage of Mumbai and India for over a century. The college is known for its strong design pedagogy, historical legacy, and alumni who have made significant contributions to Indian architecture.

records.name: MAEER MIT Institute of Design
records.description: MAEER's MIT Institute of Design Pune offers undergraduate and postgraduate design programs as part of the Maharashtra Academy of Engineering and Educational Research. The institute provides BDes programs in communication design, interior design, and fashion design with an emphasis on creative problem-solving and industry readiness. It is part of the well-established MIT group in Pune and benefits from shared resources and industry connections across the group's institutions.
